## HeartMuLa

Nodes: [BobRandomNumber/ComfyUI-HeartMuLa](https://github.com/BobRandomNumber/ComfyUI-HeartMuLa) — the V3-schema pack, with separate LLM and codec loaders so the 15 GB generator and the 6 GB codec are never resident at the same time.

The tag vocabulary below is adapted from [filliptm/ComfyUI_FL-HeartMuLa](https://github.com/filliptm/ComfyUI_FL-HeartMuLa)'s Tags Builder. [benjiyaya/HeartMuLa_ComfyUI](https://github.com/benjiyaya/HeartMuLa_ComfyUI) is the third wrapper — it adds bitsandbytes 4-bit storage aimed at 12 GB cards. That trades ~15% generation speed for ~4 GB, which is not a trade worth making on a Spark's unified memory, so it is not carried here.

Models: [HeartMuLa](https://huggingface.co/HeartMuLa) — Apache-2.0, ungated.

### Models

```dotenv
COMFY_ASSET_PROFILES=heartmula-oss-3b
```

```
📂 ComfyUI/models/HeartMuLa/
├── gen_config.json
├── tokenizer.json
├── 📂 HeartMuLa-oss-3B-happy-new-year/     ← the generator (15 GB)
└── 📂 HeartCodec-oss-20260123/             ← the decoder (6.2 GB)
```

`base_path` is resolved against `ComfyUI/models/HeartMuLa/`, so leave it as `HeartMuLa` unless you keep the weights somewhere else. The loaders' dropdowns also list `HeartMuLa-oss-3B` and `HeartMuLa-RL-oss-3B-20260123`; the profile provisions the happy-new-year pair, which is the one upstream recommends. Add the others by hand if you want to compare.

## Writing the tags

Comma-separated, roughly genre → vocal → mood → tempo → instruments. These are the terms the model responds to most reliably:

| Axis | Terms |
| --- | --- |
| **Genre** | pop, rock, electronic, jazz, classical, hip-hop, r&b, country, folk, metal, indie |
| **Vocal** | female vocal, male vocal, duet, choir, instrumental |
| **Mood** | energetic, melancholic, uplifting, calm, aggressive, romantic, dreamy, dark |
| **Tempo** | slow, medium, fast |
| **Instruments** | piano, guitar, acoustic guitar, drums, synth, strings, brass, … |

Example: `indie rock, male vocal, melancholic, slow, acoustic guitar`

## Writing the lyrics

Section markers shape the arrangement. The official set:

`[Intro]` `[Verse]` `[Prechorus]` `[Chorus]` `[Bridge]` `[Outro]` `[Instrumental]`

English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish all work.

## Settings

- `cfg_scale` 1.5 follows the tags closely; drop toward 1.0 for more freedom.
- `temperature` 1.0 and `top_k` 50 are the defaults the model was tuned with.
- `duration_seconds` up to 300. Generation time scales with it — start at 30.
- The **Audio Post-Processor** normalises, widens the stereo image and trims rumble; set `stereo_width` to 1.0 and `normalize` off to hear the raw codec output.
